extraction_notes: MM1W3V6 is one line item of the multi-part datasheet 'MM1W3V3 THRU MM1W330' by Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com); type code FHE, SOD-123 package.

Electrical Characteristics row for MM1W3V6 (page 2, Ta = 25 C): VZ min 3.40 V / nom 3.6 V / max 3.80 V at IZT = 69 mA; maximum zener impedance ZZT = 10 ohm @ IZT; leakage IR = 100 uA max @ VR = 1 V; admissible zener current IZM = 263 mA.
Maximum Ratings (page 1): power dissipation PD = 1000 mW at Tc = 75 C; VF = 1.2 V max @ IF = 200 mA; Tj and Tstg -55 to +150 C; typical thermal resistance RthJ-A = 375 C/W.
The Electrical Parameter section on page 1 defines IZK/ZZK symbols but the per-part table gives no IZK or ZZK@IZK values for this series, so no knee-impedance point is recorded.

The only graphical figures are Fig.1 Power Derating Curve (PD vs ambient temperature: flat 1.0 W to 75 C, linearly derating to 0 W at 150 C) and Fig.2 Typical Transient Thermal Impedance (page 3). Both are thermal ratings, not electrical I-V or VZ-IZ characteristics, so no model-usable curves were digitized.
Values taken from the public datasheet PDF only (SHA-256 58bc7212021acdd0099f74f5574992e2fe4afea33850f27c443c979da297e66c); no vendor SPICE or model packs consulted.
omission_reason: No electrical characteristic curves (VF-IF, VZ-IZ, temperature coefficient, or capacitance vs VR) are present in the datasheet; the only figures are a power derating curve and a transient thermal impedance plot, which do not constitute diode electrical model curves. Extraction therefore relies on the tabulated limits: single-point VF maximum, zener voltage window at IZT, ZZT, IR leakage, and IZM.
